# My Kidz Dentist

> A Phoenix-based pediatric dental practice offering comprehensive dental care for children including preventive services, sedation dentistry, and specialized treatments.

My Kidz Dentist is a pediatric dental practice in Phoenix, Arizona, led by experienced pediatric dentists including Dr. Bobby Yang, Dr. Skaugrud, Dr. Blaser, and Dr. Hom. The practice specializes in making dental care comfortable and accessible for children through various sedation options, preventive care, and patient education resources.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Children's Dental Care
- Nitrous Oxide Sedation
- Baby Teeth Care
- Preventive Dentistry
- Dental Fillings & Cavities
- Root Canal Treatment
- Dental Crowns
- Orthodontics
- Mouthguards
- Early Treatment
- Oral Hygiene
- Special Needs Dentistry
- Phoenix, Arizona
- American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry

## Core Services

- [Services](https://www.mykidzdentist.com/services): Pediatric dental services including sedation and preventive dentistry
- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://www.mykidzdentist.com/services/pediatric-dentistry): Core pediatric dentistry services including cleanings and exams
- [Baby Teeth](https://www.mykidzdentist.com/services/baby-teeth): Baby teeth care and infant dental health services in Phoenix, AZ
- [Cavities](https://www.mykidzdentist.com/services/cavities): Cavity treatment, prevention, and dental fillings for children
- [Root Canal](https://www.mykidzdentist.com/services/root-canal): Root canal and pulpotomy treatment for infected baby teeth
- [Crowns](https://www.mykidzdentist.com/services/crowns): Dental crowns for baby teeth using stainless steel and zirconia

## Specialized Treatments

- [Nitrous Oxide](https://www.mykidzdentist.com/services/nitrous-oxide): Nitrous oxide sedation dentistry for anxious children in Phoenix
- [Orthodontics](https://www.mykidzdentist.com/services/orthodontics): Pediatric orthodontics and braces consultation in Phoenix, AZ
- [Mouthguard](https://www.mykidzdentist.com/services/mouthguard): Custom mouthguard for sports protection and bruxism prevention
